description: Personalized English Exercises - AI-generated practice exercises based on user's identified weaknesses with spaced repetition and progress tracking

userStories.title: Create exercise database tables
userStories.description: As a developer, I need database tables to store exercises, attempts, and weakness progress so the system can track learning over time.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'exercises' table: id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY), type (TEXT), instruction (TEXT), content (TEXT JSON), difficulty (INTEGER 1-5), targetWeakness (TEXT), createdAt (TEXT), sourceAnalysisId (INTEGER nullable), dailySetDate (TEXT nullable)

Add 'exercise_attempts' table: id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY), exerciseId (INTEGER), userAnswer (TEXT JSON), isCorrect (INTEGER 0/1), partialScore (REAL nullable), feedback (TEXT), attemptedAt (TEXT), timeSpentSeconds (INTEGER)

Add 'weakness_progress' table: id (INTEGER PRIMARY KEY), weaknessCategory (TEXT UNIQUE), totalAttempts (INTEGER default 0), correctAttempts (INTEGER default 0), lastPracticed (TEXT nullable), nextReviewDate (TEXT nullable), masteryLevel (INTEGER 0-100 default 0)
Add appropriate indexes on exerciseId, weaknessCategory, nextReviewDate, dailySetDate
Tables created on app launch if not exists
Typecheck/build passes
